description:
**Almost certainly incompatible with 2.2.0 saves**

Original mod by: Komeiji Satori

A PL breakaway faction with a varied lineup of ships, weapons, and fighters.

While Loulan ships cover a wide variety of design philosophies, they all benefit from the same set of "Tac-Mods" which provide unique benefits relating to the consumption and/or restoration of the ship's hull level. They also have access to a range of... eccentric weapons.

[Notable] changes since 2.1.9 (check Changelog_EN file for full):
```
Graphicslib dependency replaced with BoxUtil 

UNGP rules adjusted/renamed
Chaos Armament renamed "Chaos Arsenal" (I think it sounds better)
Charge Lance (& Integrated version) reworked into "Chaos Flail": flux-free(!) but expensive weapon with deeply unreliable output

Arc Field hullmod renamed "Phasebolt Field" and buffed in various ways
Other small balance changes
```


FORUM THREAD UNDER CONSTRUCTION

*Probably* save compatible with number-changed older versions

Download link: https://drive.google.com/uc?export=download&id=1lOmu5Uuzebv9TSBu9YHkBTsVVvPWv7BX
